svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
When it is seen: line and load regulation measurement of a converter (one image for all cases).
What to draw: from left to right: the power supply (with + in red and − in blue) going to the
input of the converter under test; the output of the converter goes to the electronic load
(short and thick cables) and, with thin wires, to the voltmeter (or to a channel of the
Details: the thin voltmeter wires attached to the output terminals of the converter, not at the
end of the load cables (the drop in the cables is not regulation); if you wish, a second thin
wire from the voltmeter to the input terminals (dashed: needed only if the input is also read).
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
